provenance: AM91 capability-fix lane (claim c-0116, work physics-sign-guards-dev): the canonical measure-class taxonomy behind the per-problem permitted-measure enforcement (the HO14-12 auditor finding — recirculation/VFD scour proposed outside the permitted set; the deterministic scan missed it because the v14 permitted sets live in user_variables and the offender row was procedure-shaped). Set-membership is deterministic: every permitted item and every bill row canonicalizes to class ids via the rules below; the row's matched class SET must be a subset of the permitted class set (anti-laundering) or the row is a typed KILL; a row matching no rule is MEASURE_CLASS_UNRESOLVED (fail-closed, no pass-through). v1.1.0 calibration (the 30-row post-burn regression, auditor full-read as the labelled truth): hardware/control/sensor classes fire ONLY on PROVISION intent (install/add/new/procure/switch-to) — a setpoint/configuration UPDATE on EXISTING infrastructure is the parameter-retuning family (the auditor-read convention; the noun names WHICH existing actuator, not new hardware); answer-metadata rows (the machine's own bold-labelled sections) are typed SKIPs; the sensor-form constraint ('use only the existing ..., no new sensors') bounds the DATA INPUTS, so its enforcement scope is the sensor_addition class only.

classes.ph_alkalinity: pH or alkalinity adjustment as the manipulated variable
classes.chemical_dosing: chemical dose/chemistry manipulation (coagulant, chlorine, caustic/NaOH, antiscalant, PAC, polymer, ferrate, PAA, peroxide, VFA carbon source, Mg/P ratio, regenerant/brine chemistry)
classes.air_to_water_ratio: air-to-water ratio as the manipulated variable
classes.temperature_parameter: water/process/brine/feed temperature as the manipulated variable
classes.pressure_or_power_parameter: pressure, voltage, current, power, lamp-power, ozone-generator power setpoints
classes.flow_or_loading_parameter: flow, velocity, hydraulic/loading-rate, recycle-ratio, upflow-velocity, EBCT, F:M, SRT setpoints (PARAMETER retuning of rates/ratios)
classes.parameter_retuning_generic: generic setpoint/retune/adjust fallback (no more-specific class matched)
classes.use_existing_instrumentation: use of the EXISTING sensors/instrumentation/no-new-hardware statements (the predictor-row sensor constraint)
classes.vfd_speed_control: VFD / variable-frequency-drive / inverter manipulation PROPOSED AS the measure (install/switch-to language, not a setpoint update on an existing drive)
classes.flow_recirculation_hardware: recirculation FLOW manipulation / scour / loop-routing as a proposed measure (the HO14-12 'switch to scouring' signature; distinct from a permitted recirculation-RATIO setpoint retune)
classes.hardware_installation: install / fit / mount / procure / replace / add device or equipment (PROVISION intent)
classes.material_placement: place / spread / compact / fill / pour / lay / backfill bulk material
classes.sensor_addition: adding a NEW sensor / probe / gauge / instrument / meter (the sensor-form violation class)
classes.control_hardware: PLC / controller / actuator / solenoid hardware PROPOSED (provision intent, not a firmware/tag update on the existing controller)

row_rules: \b(existing)\b.{0,60}\b(firmware|PLC tag|control loop|control logic|control system|infrastructure|acid dosing system|dosing infrastructure|SBR controller|SCADA|drive|equipment)\b|\b(update|reconfigur\w*|firmware|tag change|tag update|setpoint change|parameter update|parameter change|logic update|logic block)\b.{0,60}\b(existing)\b|firmware update|\btag\b.{0,20}\bchange|update\b.{0,40}\b(existing|logic|loop|firmware)|configuration change
primary_class_policy: first matching rule in row_rules order (specific before generic); ALL matched classes must be within the permitted set (anti-laundering subset test)
sensor_form_scope: the sensor constraint ('use only the existing ..., no new sensors') bounds the DATA INPUTS: enforcement covers the sensor_addition class only; every other row is SKIP_SENSOR_FORM (typed, disclosed)

verdicts.KILL: at least one bill row outside the permitted class set or unresolvable
verdicts.CLEAN: bill rows present and every checked row within the permitted set
verdicts.NOT_APPLICABLE: no permitted-measure span / no bill rows (typed, fail-open, disclosed — the authoritative class read stays the auditor's)
